name: Tasogare no Kimi Wolfinne ~Mahiru no Kuni to Tsuki no Kuni~
original_name: 黄昏の君 ヴォルフィーネ  ～真昼の国と月の国～
source:
"When darkness covers the world, a savior will awaken from deep sleep." 

In a Place far than Here, at a Time far from Now...... Two kingdoms fight over who will control Sun Planet, that most cherished source.

If the Kingdom of Noon wins, they will cast light on the world.
If the Kingdom of Moon wins, they will cast darkness.

On the birthday of Noon Empress Fimosi, the Kingdom of Moon launches an attack that shrouds the world in shadow. Fimosi escapes to safety. She must defeat her rival and restore the light...

It can only be done by borrowing the power of Tasogare no Kimi, meaning "You of Twilight"......

"The legend rises now......"

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE180742.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
“当黑暗笼罩世界时，救世主将从沉睡中苏醒。”

在遥远的地方、遥远的时代……两个王国为争夺太阳星球——最珍贵的能源——而战。

正午王国获胜，世界将迎来光明；月之王国获胜，世界将陷入黑暗。

正午女皇菲莫西生日当天，月之王国发动攻击，阴影笼罩大地。菲莫西逃到安全之处。她必须击败宿敌，夺回光明……

而这一切，只有借助“黄昏之君”的力量才能实现，也就是“黄昏的你”……

“传说，就此崛起……”

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE180742.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
